goal: Goal 17 professional offline render lookdev material split
sourceBoundary: Original STEP, brochure PDF, and fixed-ball-valve.glb are read-only inputs and must not be overwritten.
renderBoundary: Goal 17 prepares offline lookdev and three still targets only; it does not render a 240-frame sequence and does not connect to the homepage.

referencePages.use: Primary commercial product material hierarchy and contrast reference.
Fixed-ball-valve exploded order, seat system, and configuration-table reference.
State and composition continuity reference; not accepted as final material quality.

lookdevDiagnosis: Goal 16 solved the all-stainless direction and state grouping, but it still reads like a real-time WebGL preview.
The brochure references get realism from material contrast: satin shell, polished cuts, dark cavities, dark fasteners, soft seals, and controlled black/white reflections.
The next material pass must split stainless into multiple roughness and reflection families instead of assigning one silver material to every part.

layers.label: Satin cast stainless pressure shell
layers.brochureCue: The fixed-ball-valve shell reads as smooth but not mirror-like; large curved forms keep broad soft highlights and visible midtone body.
layers.assignmentRule: Large center/right body groups after geometry classification.
layers.acceptance: Body keeps readable grey-silver mass, does not bleach into white, and receives black-card reflection bands.

layers.label: Machined flange and cut-face stainless
layers.brochureCue: Flange rims and cut faces carry stronger bright/dark strip reflections than the cast body.
layers.assignmentRule: Left/right axial shell and large circular elements, especially far-side pipeline-axis parts.
layers.acceptance: Rims have crisp edge highlights and dark slots inside bolt holes.

layers.label: Polished stainless ball core
layers.brochureCue: Ball core is the cleanest specular object in exploded structure views.
layers.assignmentRule: Only the true sphere-like ball mesh receives this material and ball quarter-turn motion.
layers.acceptance: Ball shows hard studio reflections without dragging valve seats or seat seals.

layers.label: Darkened bolts, nuts, washers, sockets
layers.brochureCue: Brochure products gain scale and credibility from dark hardware and black hole interiors.
layers.assignmentRule: English fastener names and tiny repeated hardware from model audit, plus small geometry clusters.
layers.acceptance: Fasteners separate from the shell at first glance and stop the render from becoming one flat silver object.

layers.label: Light soft-seat / PTFE visual treatment
layers.brochureCue: Soft-seat explanatory drawings use pale non-metallic inserts distinct from metal parts.
layers.assignmentRule: Thin axial rings near the ball and named seat/seal candidates.
layers.acceptance: Seats stay fixed during ball motion and remain visible without turning pure white.

layers.label: Graphite packing and dark internal cavity
layers.brochureCue: Internal holes and packing zones read as controlled black, not flat grey.
layers.assignmentRule: Named packing/gasket candidates and small dark source-material nodes; may need manual review after first Cycles still.
layers.acceptance: Bores, packing, and undercuts create real black-level contrast.

layers.label: Machined stem, shaft, drive and support stack
layers.brochureCue: Vertical drive details use bright machined metal but should remain separate from the body material.
layers.assignmentRule: Upper drive and lower support groups from Goal 16 state classification.
layers.acceptance: Drive stack produces narrow vertical highlights and remains legible in close-up.

manualReviewRequired: The GLB carries mojibake names and duplicate node names, so material grouping must be validated visually after the first Blender render.
Brochure material tables mention multiple possible materials and seat forms; web copy must not assert a material grade until the client approves it.
The red actuator/pipeline in the brochure is not present as matching geometry in the current GLB; Goal 17 must not invent it unless a new CAD asset is supplied.
